name: Tina Ariosto
source: A cheerful and energetic gunner who is a bit of a ditz. She is a good sniper that has defeated many powerful monsters, and is a popular celebrity in her home town. She has a boyfriend she is madly in love with, and is sexually active as well. She is close friends with the mage, and is proved with magic bullets.
